about: The moves placed by hand: the rows of docs/ANIMATIONS.md marked "made here", which no animation library has.
The game reads this file (static/js/athlete.js). The "See every move" page edits it (Edit this move) and saves it
from the host's computer, keeping the file it replaces in move_saves/.
Places are metres in the athlete's own frame: x to its left, y up from the floor, z forward. The arms and legs
bend to reach them. hand: where the wrist goes; pole: the way the elbow (or knee) points; fingers and palm: the way
the fingers point and the palm faces. Turns are radians: the chest's turn + to the left, a lean + forward.
Keys are [time, value]: in between, the value eases from one key to the next, stopping at each one. A key
[time, value, "pass"] is passed through without stopping. blend: the seconds a move takes to come in and to go.

GUARD_L.about: D1, the guard while charging: the left forearm across in front of the face, the palm towards it. The hand's place is where the face is when the body stands straight: it follows the head when the body bends.

CARRY_R.about: B1 and B2, holding the ball: the right hand in front of the right hip, palm up, steady as the player runs. meet: where it comes to take a caught ball from the left hand (D7).

CATCH_L.about: D5 and D6, the catch: the left arm straight out in front at the shoulder's height, the palm turned forward and the fingers up (a palm blast). chest: the chest turned to the right, so the left shoulder comes forward. It comes in over blend.in and goes over the catch's recovery (a rule).

PULL_L.about: D7, a caught ball: the left hand pulls it in to the stomach, the palm turned towards the right hand, which takes it. The elbow points as in the catch.

PARRY_L.about: D2 to D4, the deflect: a backhand parry with the left hand. The forearm across the chest, the back of the hand to the ball; then it swings out to the left like a door on its hinge, the back of the hand leading, the chest unwinding with it. Time 0 to 1: the deflect's window and recovery.

THROWS.about: C4 to C7, the side-arm and underarm throws (the overhead one is a clip): the right hand wound up with the charge (wind: time 0 to 1 over the charge), then released (release: time 0 to 1 over 0.42 s). Not the hips: moving them would put the feet through the floor. blend: all three throws, the overhead one too.

side.about: Side-arm: the hand out to the right at the stomach's height, further as it charges, then swept across the front. turnWind, turnRelease: the chest's turn.

under.about: Underarm, like bowling: the hand down and back, below the waist, then swung through low. bendWind, bendRelease: the upper body bent forward.

DASH_SIDE.about: E2, the dash to the right (E3, to the left, mirrors it). Time 0 to 1: the dash itself (the rules' dash time); 1 to 2: the landing and settling. hips: moved [towards the dash's side, up, forward] from where they stand; lead (the foot on the dash's side) and trail: the ankles [towards the dash's side, lifted, forward]; bend: the upper body bent forward; knees: the way the left knee points (the right's mirrors it). The lead foot lifts a little, the trail foot pushes the body across, the upper body tilts forward and down; the lead foot comes down and takes the weight.

DASH_FORWARD.about: E4, the dash forward: half-crouched, one big step forward with the left foot, the right pushing behind. As the side dash, with hips moved [left, up, forward] and L and R the left and right ankles [left, lifted, forward].

DASH_BACK.about: E5, the dash back: a jump back, still facing forward: down, up and back, landing soft. As the dash forward.
